registered: 2026-11-25, before KinematiK was run on this pack. DISCLOSURE: the measured curves were read before this file was written (to find the inputs); they are in Fig. 14 only, read by eye to about +-0.3 C.

source.reference: Saw, Ye, Tay, Chong, Kuan, Yew, Computational fluid dynamic and thermal analysis of Lithium-ion battery pack with air cooling, Applied Energy 177 (2016) 783-792
source.pack: 24 LFP 38120 cells (8 Ah, 3.2 V, 0.335 kg, 38 mm x 146 mm, cp 998 J/kg K, internal resistance 3.4 mOhm, Table 1), 12S2P, 5 mm spacing, air from a tangential blower at 30 g/s through venting holes in the holding plates, chamber at 30 C; 24 T-type thermocouples mid-body; constant-current charge from fully discharged at 1, 3 and 5 It (8, 24 and 40 A per cell)

mapping: KinematiK's lumped cell temperature (ev_electrical_check.pack_temperature_along) per cell: heat I^2 R with R = 3.4 mOhm (Table 1) at the per-cell current, heat capacity 0.335 x 998 J/K, cooling hA with h = Nu k / D = 76.4 x 0.0263 / 0.038 W/m2K over the cell's side area (pi D L). The h is the paper's own CFD figure, not KinematiK's airflow map: the pack's flow along the cells through holder holes is not a layout KinematiK's map models, so this test checks KinematiK's heating and thermal-mass model, not its airflow model.

tests.absolute: mean cell rise at the end of each charge within 30 % of the measurement
tests.decision: which charge rates take the cells past 40 C (a 10 C rise from 30 C): measured, only 5 It. KinematiK must flag the same rates.

registered_2.registered: 2026-11-25, after the first run failed and before this test was run. Not blind: the measured heats and rises were known, and a hand estimate suggested a calibrated model could match.
registered_2.why: KinematiK's pack thermal model says absolute temperatures are trustworthy only once calibrated from a cell heat test and a measured pack run. This tests that calibrated workflow with held-out data.
registered_2.model: pack_thermal.PackThermalModel itself: a 4 x 6 grid of the 24 cells, 12S2P (pack current 16, 48, 80 A), LFP cell (0.335 kg, 998 J/kg K, side area pi D L), cell-to-cell conduction at the module default, uniform cooling (AirflowParams duct mode with no flow, so every cell sees h_floor), no wake warming, ambient 30 C, resistance temperature coefficient 0.
registered_2.calibration: (1) heat: KinematiK's heat law Q = I^2 R + I T dU/dT fitted exactly to the calorimeter's average heat at 1 and 5 It (the linear term lumps entropic and polarisation heat, so the fitted dU/dT is not the cell's true entropic coefficient); (2) cooling: h_floor fitted so the 5 It run's mean cell rise at 600 s matches the measured 10.9 C.

tests.heat_held_out: the fitted heat law at 3 It within 10 % of the measured 4.03 W
tests.temperature_held_out: mean cell rise at the end of the 1 It (2700 s) and 3 It (1100 s) runs within 30 % of the measurement
tests.decision: the same rates flagged as passing 40 C as measured (only 5 It)
